name: bharathbuild-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper that turns the BharathBuild web app into Android & iOS apps

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs bundleRelease
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
